title: Multi-hop Evidence Pursuit Meets the Web: Team Papelo at FEVER 2024

live_model.evidence: We implement Algorithm 1 using GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13, seed 42) as the LLM, T5 (t5-large) as the sequence-to-sequence model, and Google as the web search engine (Section 4)

prompt.location: Appendix B (prompts for GetFirstQuestion, GetNextQuestion, LLMAnswer, LLMVerdict and AllAtOnce)
prompt.note: The LLM+LLM row uses GPT-4o for all question generation, avoiding the authors' fine-tuned T5.

claim.location: Table 2, row LLM+LLM (first 200 examples of the AVeriTeC dev set)

data.source: AVeriTeC dev set (public); evidence retrieved by live Google search and scraped with trafilatura

notes: Soft gap: live web search results drift, and the official AVeriTeC scorer is needed. The submitted system (0.486 on the full dev set, Table 3) relies on an author-fine-tuned T5 whose release is not stated.

resolution.plan: Live web retrieval drifts and the official scorer is external, but both are public: run Algorithm 1 in the LLM+LLM configuration (all question generation by gpt-4o-2024-05-13, seed 42) with the Appendix B prompts, Google search and trafilatura scraping on the first 200 AVeriTeC dev claims, and score with the shared-task AVeriTeC scorer (Schlichtkrull et al. 2023 baseline release, lambda=0.25) against Table 2 (0.385).
resolution.approximation: Search results at run time differ from mid-2024; Google API access needed; scorer thresholds as released.
